messages:
ria: Auditor Amy asked for a concise evidence bundle for INC-2026-0503: KMS key policy snapshots, CloudTrail KMS events, STS AssumeRole correlation, and a signed manifest. Can someone take this?
evidence-bot: Playbook: include exporter identity, file->sha256 mapping, presign creator + CloudTrail PutObject entry, and control mapping (SOC2 CC6.2, ISO27001 A.9.2.1). See internal playbook link.
oz: I can pull CloudTrail + KMS describe/list-grants. Do we also want kube RoleBinding diffs for the same window?
auditor-amy: Yes. Provide kube-audit excerpts and RoleBinding before/after if present. Prefer graphml for access graph and CSV for quick review.
ria: Plan: 1) CloudTrail filter for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey & AssumeRole 2) kms describe-key + get-key-policy + list-grants 3) kubectl rolebinding diffs + kube-audit 4) run iam_graph -> graphml 5) tarball + sha256 + detached GPG sig, upload to evidence bucket with object-lock.
oz: Commands I'll run (abbreviated):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time "2026-04-02T02:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-04-02T06:00:00Z" > ct_encrypt.json
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/aa11bb22 > kms_describe.json
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/aa11bb22 > kms_grants.json
kubectl get rolebinding,myrole -n prod -o yaml > myrole_after.yaml
python tools/iam_graph.py --keys key_arns.txt --output inc0503_access.graphml
```
oncall: When uploading, call sts:GetCallerIdentity before presign and include that output in manifest. Set S3 Object Lock retention to 30 days and tag evidence:INC-2026-0503. Retain CloudTrail object keys in manifest.
auditor-amy: For proofs we expect: tar.gz sha256 checksum, detached GPG signature (public key fingerprint in manifest), time window, exported_by and presign_creator fields. Also note any key rotation activity in the window.
ria: I'll prepare a short timeline.md correlating KMS events and RoleBinding changes. Omit full presigned URL in Slack; put it only in evidence tracker.
oz: Creating tarball and signature now:
```
tar czf inc0503_evidence_v1.tar.gz ct_*.json kms_*.json myrole_after.yaml inc0503_access.graphml kube-audit.json timeline.md
sha256sum inc0503_evidence_v1.tar.gz > inc0503.sha256
gpg --output inc0503.sig --detach-sign --local-user compliance@redwood-internal inc0503_evidence_v1.tar.gz
```
oz: Uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0503/ with object-lock enabled and created a 7d presign (logged). I captured sts:GetCallerIdentity output and saved as presign_identity.json.
ria: Added RoleBinding diff excerpt to timeline.md and noted control mappings: [\"SOC2 CC6.2\",\"ISO27001 A.9.2.1\"].
auditor-amy: Received package. I'll validate checksum and GPG signature; ping if raw CloudTrail S3 objects or extended kube-audit retention are needed. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
evidence-bot: Evidence package created: INC-2026-0503/evidence-v1. Follow playbook for handoff.
